chapterInfo.content:
72
Asomdwoeɛ hene ne n’ahennie
Salomo deɛ.
1Onyankopɔn, fa w’atemmuo ma ɔhene,
ne wo tenenee ma ɔhene ba.
2Ma no mfa tenenee nni wo man so,
na ɔmfa atemmuo nhwɛ w’amanehunufoɔ.
3 # Dwom 85.8-13 Mmepɔ bɛso asomdwoeɛ ama ɔman,
na nkokoɔ nso de tenenee aba.
4 # Dwom 72.12 Ɔbɛbu ɔman mu amanehunufoɔ atɛn,
na wagye ahiafoɔ mma nkwa,
na wabubu nhyɛsofoɔ mu pasapasa.
5Owia ne ɔsrane da so wɔ hɔ yi,
wɔbɛsuro wo, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
6Ɔbɛba sɛ osuo a ɛtɔ gu ɛserɛ a wɔahu soɔ so,
sɛ osu kɛseɛ a ɛtɔ dwodwo asase mu.
7Ɔteneneeni bɛsi frɔmm ne berɛ so,
na asomdwoeɛ pii bɛba akɔduru sɛ ɔsrane nni hɔ bio.
8 # Sak 9.10 Ɔbɛdi hene afiri po so akɔsi po so,
de afiri asubɔnten no so akɔsi asase ano.
9 # Yes 49.23 Wɔn a wɔte serɛ so bɛkoto n’anim,
na n’atamfo atafere mfuturo.
10 # Dwom 68.29; Yes 60.9 Tarsis ne nsupɔ mu ahemfo
bɛba abɛyɛ ayɛ,
Saba ne Seba ahemfo bɛba abɛkyɛ adeɛ.
11 # Dwom 2.8, 10-12 Na ahemfo nyinaa bɛkoto asɔre no,
amanaman nyinaa bɛsom no.
12 # Hiob 36.15; Dwom 35.10 Na ɔbɛgye ohiani a ɔsu frɛ no,
ne ɔmanehunufoɔ a ɔnni boafoɔ.
13Ɔbɛkora ɔbrɛfoɔ ne ohiani,
na wagye ahiafoɔ nkwa.
14 # Dwom 9.12 Ɔbɛgye wɔn afiri nhyɛsoɔ ne atirimuɔdensɛm mu,
na wɔn mogya boɔ ayɛ den n’anim.
15 # Dwom 72.10; 84.9 Na ɔbɛnya nkwa,
na ɔde Seba sika no bi bɛma no,
na ɔno nso bɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama no daa,
ahyira no da mu nyinaa.
16Asase no so aburoofuo bɛduru mmepɔ atifi,
ɛso aba bɛwoso
sɛ Lebanon,
na nkuro no asoa
sɛ asase so nwira.
17 # Gye 12.3; 22.18 Ne din bɛtena hɔ daa,
na owia wɔ hɔ yi ne din asi so,
na nnipa de no ahyira wɔn ho,
na amanaman nyinaa ahyira no.
18Nhyira ne AWURADE Nyankopɔn,
Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔno nko yɛ anwanwadeɛ,
19 # Dwom 41.13; Yes 6.3 na nhyira ne n’animuonyam din daa,
na n’animuonyam nhyɛ asase nyinaa ma.
Amen ne Amen.
20Yisai ba Dawid mpaebɔ asa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Onyankopɔn, fa w’atemmuo ma ɔhene,
ne wo tenenee ma ɔhene ba.
Ma no mfa tenenee nni wo man so,
na ɔmfa atemmuo nhwɛ w’amanehunufoɔ.
Mmepɔ bɛso asomdwoeɛ ama ɔman,
na nkokoɔ nso de tenenee aba.
Ɔbɛbu ɔman mu amanehunufoɔ atɛn,
na wagye ahiafoɔ mma nkwa,
na wabubu nhyɛsofoɔ mu pasapasa.
Owia ne ɔsrane da so wɔ hɔ yi,
wɔbɛsuro wo, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
Ɔbɛba sɛ osuo a ɛtɔ gu ɛserɛ a wɔahu soɔ so,
sɛ osu kɛseɛ a ɛtɔ dwodwo asase mu.
Ɔteneneeni bɛsi frɔmm ne berɛ so,
na asomdwoeɛ pii bɛba akɔduru sɛ ɔsrane nni hɔ bio.
Ɔbɛdi hene afiri po so akɔsi po so,
de afiri asubɔnten no so akɔsi asase ano.
Wɔn a wɔte serɛ so bɛkoto n’anim,
na n’atamfo atafere mfuturo.
Tarsis ne nsupɔ mu ahemfo
bɛba abɛyɛ ayɛ,
Saba ne Seba ahemfo bɛba abɛkyɛ adeɛ.
Na ahemfo nyinaa bɛkoto asɔre no,
amanaman nyinaa bɛsom no.
Na ɔbɛgye ohiani a ɔsu frɛ no,
ne ɔmanehunufoɔ a ɔnni boafoɔ.
Ɔbɛkora ɔbrɛfoɔ ne ohiani,
na wagye ahiafoɔ nkwa.
Ɔbɛgye wɔn afiri nhyɛsoɔ ne atirimuɔdensɛm mu,
na wɔn mogya boɔ ayɛ den n’anim.
Na ɔbɛnya nkwa,
na ɔde Seba sika no bi bɛma no,
na ɔno nso bɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama no daa,
ahyira no da mu nyinaa.
Asase no so aburoofuo bɛduru mmepɔ atifi,
ɛso aba bɛwoso
sɛ Lebanon,
na nkuro no asoa
sɛ asase so nwira.
Ne din bɛtena hɔ daa,
na owia wɔ hɔ yi ne din asi so,
na nnipa de no ahyira wɔn ho,
na amanaman nyinaa ahyira no.
Nhyira ne AWURADE Nyankopɔn,
Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔno nko yɛ anwanwadeɛ,
na nhyira ne n’animuonyam din daa,
na n’animuonyam nhyɛ asase nyinaa ma.
Amen ne Amen.

Yisai ba Dawid mpaebɔ asa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
